title: LIVE AIR TEMPERATURE
source_name: NOAA/NCEP HRRR 3 km 2 m temperature analysis, hourly cycles
variable: TMP 2 m above ground, analysis step
what: Near-surface (2 m) air temperature from the operational HRRR analysis. Banded 5-degree key (-60..150 F): blue-white extreme cold, gray-blue subfreezing, royal-blue freezing wall (30-40), frigid turquoise/blues (40-55), lime/teal transition (55-70), mellow yellows (70-85), orange/gold warming (85-100), scorching pink/reds past 100. Every band brightened so nothing renders dark.
why_extreme: Extreme cold anchors near-white blue-white; extreme heat anchors vivid pink/red; ordinary temperatures own most of the key.
